passive.name: Glorious Evolution
passive.description: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. With every 100 Hex Fragments he obtains, Viktor permanently augments an active ability. After upgrading all of his basic abilities, he can gather 100 Hex Fragments to augment his ultimate ability.

spells.name: Siphon Power
spells.description: Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing magic damage and granting Viktor Shield for seconds. Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals magic damage. Upgraded: Grants Shield and Viktor additionally gains % Move Speed for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalMissileDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Gravity Field
spells.description: Viktor deploys a gravitational imprisonment device for seconds, Slowing enemies inside it by %. Enemies who remain within its radius for 1.25 seconds are Stunned for seconds. Upgraded Passive: Viktor's Abilities Slow by % for 1 second.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Hextech Ray
spells.description: Viktor fires a hextech ray in a chosen direction, dealing magic damage to any enemies it hits. Upgraded: An aftershock follows Hextech Ray, dealing magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation LaserDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Arcane Storm
spells.description: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm in an area for seconds, which instantly deals magic damage followed by magic damage per second to surrounding enemies. The storm automatically follows champions it has recently damaged. Recast: Viktor can manually move the storm. Upgraded: The storm moves % faster. If a champion that the storm has damaged dies, the storm increases its size and its duration by seconds (up to times).
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation InitialBurstDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
